events.speaker: DELPHINE
events.text: Sit down. I'll deal you a fair hand, which is more than you can say for most tables in Griffin.

events.speaker: DELPHINE
events.text: There. Beat me straight. I respect that more than I'd respect you losing on purpose.

events.speaker: DELPHINE
events.text: A place, not a stake in the pot. I've quit better games than this for less.

events.speaker: DELPHINE
events.text: I read tables for a living. You I had to actually watch to figure out.
